title: rosa moschata var. arborea
intro: Rosa moschata var. arborea, commonly known as the climbing musk rose or musk rose tree, is a fragrant and ornamental climber belonging to the Rosa genus. It is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Rosa moschata var. arborea include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and insomnia, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as geraniol and beta-sitosterol, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
